1.explanation: BpmnSpaceTool.js orchestrates which shapes get resized by the space tool. It currently only filters out TextAnnotation shapes, so empty pools remain in the resizingShapes list and get stretched. SpaceToolBehavior.js calculates minimum dimensions for Participants but still allows them to grow vertically when they have no child lanes. To stop empty pools from resizing, BpmnSpaceTool.calculateAdjustments must also exclude Participants without lanes, and/or SpaceToolBehavior.getMinDimensions must treat empty pools as having both fixed min and max height.
1.bug_scenario: The animation shows an empty BPMN pool (a Participant with no lanes) being pushed and stretched vertically when the user applies the space tool above it. Dotted guide‐lines appear and the pool’s height grows, even though empty pools are supposed to have a fixed, unresizable height to distinguish them.
